title: Small steps: Consequence without threat
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
pressureLine: You'll be sorry if you do that again.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The consequence must be clear and related.
practice: state the related consequence without fear or humiliation
principle: Use consequences to teach responsibility rather than threaten belonging.
nextSentence: The consequence must be clear and related. First, state the related consequence without fear or humiliation.
keyLearning: Use consequences to teach responsibility rather than threaten belonging.
